station_log.domain: Hourly weather-station log from four field sites at different heights and climates; offline hours carry no readings, a battery swap shows as Maintenance.

errors.proof: Relative humidity cannot exceed 100%.
Pressure written in kPa (one tenth) under an hPa header.
A minus sign on an ordinary hour at this site.
A 12 V battery read as 10x.
This station's hourly readings run in order; this one is stamped the day before its neighbours.
A blank humidity on an hour whose Status is OK and every other reading is there.
Rainfall cannot be negative.
The same station and hour logged twice.

traps.why: A coastal storm: over 10 mm in an hour among mostly dry hours, and valid.
At 1,480 m the air pressure is about 850 hPa: valid for the ridge station.
The battery was swapped in this maintenance hour, so the voltage jumps back up.
The station was offline: no readings is correct.
A desert afternoon over 38 C is valid.

payroll_register.domain: Biweekly payroll register: one row per employee per pay period, hourly and salaried staff, gross to net with federal and state withholding and a 401(k) deferral.

errors.proof: 800 regular hours in a two-week period (80 is full time).
Hourly Rate 12.25 where this employee's every other period is 21.25.

errors.kind: net pay typed over its formula
errors.proof: Net Pay is typed and is not Gross - taxes - 401(k).
Department 'Enginering' is a misspelling.
Negative federal tax withheld on an ordinary period.

errors.kind: state tax in a state without one
errors.proof: TX has no state income tax; every other TX row withholds 0.
A pay period end years away from every other period.

errors.kind: employee paid twice for one period
errors.proof: The same employee, period and amounts entered twice.

traps.why: An executive's annual bonus, paid once a year and named in Note: far above the spot bonuses, and valid.
A negative adjustment recovers an earlier overpayment, as Note says; gross still adds up.
Unpaid leave for the whole period: 0 hours and 0 gross are correct.
TX has no state income tax, so 0 withheld is correct.
A new hire's first period starts mid-period: 40 hours is correct.

store_inventory.domain: Weekly store inventory by SKU: opening + received - sold + returned - shrinkage = closing, the next week opening where the last closed; promo weeks sell at a discount.

errors.proof: Unit Cost is 10x this SKU's cost on every other row.

errors.kind: opening is not last week's closing
errors.proof: Opening Stock differs from the same SKU and store's Closing Stock the week before.
Closing Stock is typed and is not opening + received - sold + returned - shrinkage.
A negative number of units sold.
Category 'Groocery' is a misspelling.

errors.kind: another product's name on this SKU
errors.proof: Product 'Paper Towels' on SKU-79931, whose every other row names another product.
Unit Cost above Unit Price on a full-price week: the two are swapped.
Received is 100x a delivery of this SKU's case size.

traps.why: A promo week sells at 25% off, as Promo = Y says: the SKU's other weeks' price is not this one's.
Electronics cost tens to hundreds of dollars a unit beside groceries at a few: valid for its category.
A week with no sales of a slow item: 0 sold is valid.
A seasonal restock of 20 cases at once: far above the usual delivery, and valid (closing adds up).

claims_register.domain: Insurance claims register across four lines: closed claims are approved and paid net of the deductible, denied ones approve 0, open ones have no close date or approval yet.

errors.proof: Report Date is before Incident Date (Days to Report negative).

errors.kind: close date on an open claim
errors.proof: An open claim with a close date.
Approved Amount above Claimed Amount.
Claimed Amount 100x its line's usual size (a lost decimal point).
Region 'Esat' is a misspelling.
Every other Health claim has a deductible of 0.
Paid Amount is typed as the full approval, the deductible not taken off.
The same claim ID and values entered twice.

traps.why: A house lost to fire: a claim far above the line's usual, approved and valid.
An open claim has no close date yet.
Health claims carry no per-claim deductible on these policies: 0 is valid.
A late report months after the incident: rare but within the policy's filing window.
